en: Multiview Romanian postcard promoting Tulcea: views of the Danube Delta with waterlilies, boats at sunset, and a fisherman with a large fish. Two modern socialist-era buildings are shown, including the Casa de Cultură and the 'Diana' universal store. Front title banner reads 'Tulcea.' The back has Romanian handwriting, an address to Bucharest, a 'POSTA ROMANA 40 BANI' stamp with the socialist coat of arms, and Bucharest postmarks.
